name: laramint/laravel-brain
description: Visualize your Laravel request lifecycle as an interactive graph

suggest.laramint/laravel-security-scanner: Install in your app (--dev) to replace Brain's built-in source security rules with the more rigorous taint-based scanner. Brain auto-detects vendor/bin/php-security-scanner and falls back to built-in rules if absent.
suggest.laravel/mcp: Install to enable `php artisan mcp:start brain` — lets Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients query the last-scanned dependency graph interactively instead of re-exporting a static snapshot. Brain auto-detects it; the server simply doesn't register if it's absent. Requires Laravel 11+ (laravel/mcp needs symfony/process ^7.4.5|^8.0.5, which conflicts with the symfony/process ^6.x that Laravel 9/10 themselves require).
